Subject: Recap + next steps from today's discovery call

Thanks again for your time today — great conversation. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we keep momentum:

Summary:
- Use case: Payments reconciliation automation for SMB merchants (batch embeddings + reconciliation assistant).
- Success metrics: 50% reduction in manual reconciliation time; <500ms median latency on embed lookups for 5k daily queries.
- Primary constraints: SOC 2 + data residency requirements, procurement window ~6-8 weeks.

ASAP asks / next steps:
1) Stakeholder map: could you confirm economic buyer + legal/procurement + security contact?
2) MAP: I'll draft a 6-week mutual action plan (tech pilot -> security review -> procurement) and share for sign-off.
3) Data access: sample sanitized dataset for a 1-week seed run (we can accept CSV or S3 path).

I'll attach a first-pass MAP template and a short checklist for security artifacts. If the timeline looks right, we can aim to start the pilot the week of 6/22.

Attachments: FinPay_MAP_v1.xlsx (spreadsheet — MAP milestones), FinPay_Security_Checklist.pdf (security questionnaire stub)

Thanks — I'll follow up with the MAP draft by tomorrow.

Best,
Marissa Cole

Marissa — thanks for the clear recap and for taking point on the MAP. Quick answers inline:

Stakeholders:
- Economic buyer: Priya Sharma (VP Product, priya@finpay.com) — final sign-off on pilot spend.
- Security lead: Jordan Patel (jordan.patel@finpay.com) — SOC 2 and network controls scope.
- Procurement: procurement@finpay.com (leads: contracts team).

Procurement window: target 6 weeks but depends on SOC 2 evidence review (could add 1-2 weeks).

Decision criteria:
- Accuracy on reconciliation use-case (sample eval set),
- Latency and cost per transaction,
- Support for on-prem/private deployment for any regulated customers.

Attachments: I'm attaching our procurement intake form (FinPay_Procurement_Checklist.pdf) and a short vendor security questionnaire (answers due 6/18).

We'll review your MAP draft. If you can show a concrete pilot plan with success metrics and an expected SOW cost estimate, Priya can sign off to kick procurement.
